title: DG2 - Minimal Capability
claim: A valid new layer must introduce at least one capability not reducible to the capabilities already present in prior layers.
assumptions: A layer that adds no new capability is a restatement rather than a derivation step.
definitions: NewCapability(C(n+1)): C(n+1) is not reducible to the union of prior capability classes.
negative_guards: Do not treat new vocabulary as a new capability.
Do not count restatement, decoration, or relabeling as derivation.
kill_conditions: A claimed layer adds only renamed prior content and still passes the DG test.
No workable criterion for capability novelty can be stated.

ledger.meaning: Source claim ingested into Lane 4 ledger.
